title: 星际旅行耗时过长且缺乏内容
description: 行星系间飞行需现实时间一到两小时，期间无事可做，只能睡觉和快进。
evidence: Want to fly between planetary systems, it takes a minimum of an hour or sometimes two in real time, all the while doing nothing but having your character sleep and using the game's super fast forward mode.
